rounds.text: Artson Ltd is a business carrying an extreme and completely unsupported valuation, evidenced by a staggering price-to-book ratio of 1327.27x on a negligible book value of ₹ 0.11 [E1]. This disconnect is further highlighted by a devastating P/E ratio of -46.78x against a healthy sector benchmark of 23.88x [E5], alongside a catastrophic ROE of -2794.99% compared to the sector benchmark of 10.27% [E8]. Fundamental performance is completely detached from these lofty market valuations, as demonstrated by poor long-term sales growth of just 2% over five years [E14] and a severe TTM profit growth contraction of -374% [E19]. Expectations have completely decoupled from business delivery, with the scanX signal engine noting that price growth exceeds profit growth by a massive 360% [E48]. Compounded profit growth over the five-year span has also collapsed by -41% [E17], underscoring deep structural decay that leaves the current market capitalisation of ₹ 539 Cr entirely unjustified [E2]. Conceded: compounded profit growth over 3 years is 15% [E18].
